page: Microsoft Azure M416s_10_v2 is an x86_64 architecture server belonging to the MSv2 family, operating on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. It features 416 dedicated vCPUs derived from 208 physical cores of Intel Xeon 8280L processors running at 2.7 GHz. The system is equipped with 9496.0 GB of system memory, yielding approximately 22.83 GB of RAM per core. Local storage consists of a 4194 GB SSD, and the instance is Premium Storage capable. No GPUs are included in this configuration, and it does not feature complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Benchmark data reveals a stark contrast between single-core and multi-core performance. Single-core metrics, such as stress-ng single-core CPU performance and single-threaded gzip compression, fall into the bottom 25% tier. Conversely, multi-core execution is highly efficient, with stress-ng multi-core CPU performance, bzip3 multi-threaded decompression, and PassMark CPU scores all ranking in the top 10% tier. Memory bandwidth is exceptionally high, with read-only small block cached bandwidth reaching 19461.33 GB/sec and large block uncached write bandwidth at 319.92 GB/sec, both placing in the top 10%. Redis SET operations also perform in the top 10% tier, executing 247.68 million operations per second.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, this server provides massive resource density, particularly in memory capacity and multi-threaded processing power, making it suitable for large-scale enterprise workloads. However, the tradeoff is its weak single-threaded performance and poor text generation speeds for LLM inference, where 7B model text generation drops to 8.12 tokens per second. Given these parameters, the server is best suited for memory-intensive applications, large-scale database operations, high-throughput Redis caching layers, and parallel multi-threaded processing tasks rather than single-threaded applications or real-time LLM text generation.
description: Microsoft Azure M416s_10_v2 is a memory-optimized server from the MSv2 family, powered by Intel Xeon 8280L processors on the x86_64 architecture. It features 416 dedicated vCPUs (208 physical cores) running at 2.7 GHz, 9496.0 GB of RAM, and a 4194 GB local SSD. Operating under Microsoft Hyper-V, this instance delivers top-tier multi-core CPU performance and memory bandwidth, as evidenced by its stress-ng multi-core and PassMark CPU scores. However, single-core performance is weak, and LLM text generation speeds are low. With its massive memory footprint and high multi-threaded throughput, this server is designed for large-scale database deployments, high-capacity caching systems like Redis, and memory-intensive enterprise workloads.
